basis: The task coordinator states, as verified by the coordinator on 2026-11-14, that this host was rented on Verda by the coordinator of this same task for this work. It is this task's own machine.
how_used: The Evo 2 scores were produced on this host. The first genomics worker's task text named a different GPU box (A100 40 GB), which stopped answering; that worker found this host through a known_hosts entry and ran the scoring on it from 17:04 UTC. At about 17:24 UTC the permission system blocked that sub-agent from connecting to an address it had not been given; per the coordinator this was not a revocation of the host. The coordinator fetched the final score file (2,150 variants), the run's metrics file and the window-choice file from the host at about 18:20 UTC. The same host also serves the project's scribe v2 track (runs/v2-gpu.jsonl).
end_state: The run's own metrics file records that the scoring process stopped by itself at 17:27:31 UTC at its time budget. The genomics fix worker did not connect to the host and did not check its current state; /root/genomics (venv and 13 GB of weights) was last reported there in runs/genomics.jsonl.
remaining_work: To complete the benchmark, score the remaining positions from the checkpoint on this host (bash genomics/run_all.sh start <seconds> window, then bash genomics/run_all.sh collect). Removing /root/genomics belongs to the coordinator's teardown of the host.
